$comment: Documents approved for publication (e.g. a sanitized lab report). Each file must be a sanitized copy, live in public/documents/ or src/assets/evidence/, and be approved by Eli. CV files are never allowed, even if listed. Entry: { "path": "public/documents/<file>.pdf", "title": "…", "sanitizedOn": "YYYY-MM-DD", "approvedOn": "YYYY-MM-DD" }.
